metadata.title: Southwest Indian Ocean & Mauritius Currents
metadata.what_you_will_try: Can you hear when the water around Mauritius is warmest, and when the eddies swirl most, without looking at the map?

timeline.accessibility_text: Mar 25, 2007: hot surface water averaging 28.4 degrees Celsius (from 17.1 to 31.2), with steady currents and some swirling eddies. You hear bright, open tones and steady pulses.
timeline.echo_callout: Southwest Indian Ocean & Mauritius Currents. Each streak is a surface current, coloured from blue at 0 to red at 32 degrees. Listen as the year unfolds.
